sources.snippet: DINOv2 is a self-supervised vision foundation model from Meta AI that learns robust visual features without any labels. Trained on a curated dataset of 142M images (LVD-142M) using a combination of DINO and iBOT objectives, it produces dense features that work across image distributions and tasks without fine-tuning.

sources.title: dinov2-large · Models
sources.snippet: Vision Transformer (large-sized model) trained using DINOv2 Vision Transformer (ViT) model trained using the DINOv2 method. It was introduced in the paper DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision by Oquab et al. and first released in this repository.
